product.title: Amazon Basics Office Stapler with 1000 Staples, 25 Sheet Capacity, Non-Slip, Black, Home Office

reviews.reviewDescription: It's funny how we have to steal stuff from home for the office. I'm occupying a new office space and there is no stapler to be found. The basics stapler does what it is supposed to do and it does it well. The all plastic case construction is okay and it staples just fine. I'm not sure of its durability but it will probably get stolen before I can figure out its life cycle. It came with staples so I don't have to search for these. Overall, it does the job effectively. Because of its economical price, I won't cry if my stapler gets stolen.

reviews.reviewDescription: This 3-pack of Amazon Basics Desktop Staplers is an excellent product that offers essential functionality and fantastic value. The staplers are lightweight, easy to use, and reliably handle their $25 \text{ sheet capacity}$. The non-slip base keeps them secure on the desk. They come with 1000 staples, meaning they are ready to use right out of the box. They are a sturdy, economical solution for routine stapling tasks in a home office or school environment.

reviews.reviewTitle: Simple, sturdy, and surprisingly satisfying — a great everyday stapler
reviews.reviewDescription: I picked up the Amazon Basics Stapler with 1000 Staples (25-sheet capacity, black) because I needed a reliable stapler for school papers, home projects, and general desk organization — and it’s turned out to be one of those small but genuinely useful purchases that quietly makes everything easier. First off, I really appreciate that it comes with 1,000 staples included. That alone makes it feel like a complete starter set right out of the box. No scrambling to find compatible staples or placing another order — you can start using it immediately, which I always love. The stapler itself feels solid and well-built. It has a nice weight to it, so it doesn’t slide around while you’re using it, and the non-slip base actually works. I can staple papers one-handed without chasing the stapler across my desk, which sounds minor but makes a big difference during busy moments. What impressed me most is how smooth and consistent it is. Staples go in cleanly every time — no bending, no half-stapled pages, no frustrating jams so far. I’ve used it on everything from a few sheets of paper to thicker packets, and it handles stacks easily within its 25-sheet capacity. The action feels firm but not stiff, so it doesn’t strain your hand even when stapling multiple sets. I also really like the simple, professional design. The black finish looks clean and modern, and it blends perfectly into any desk setup. It doesn’t feel cheap or plasticky — it feels like a proper office tool that’s built to last. Sometimes basic supplies can feel flimsy, but this one definitely doesn’t. I’ve been using it for school assignments, printed worksheets, organizing paperwork, and small craft projects, and it’s been completely reliable. It lines pages up well and holds stacks securely without tearing or damaging paper. Everything just feels neat and organized afterward. Another thing I appreciate is the classic Amazon Basics approach here: no unnecessary features, no overdesign — just a straightforward, functional stapler that does exactly what it’s supposed to do. It’s easy to load, easy to use, and dependable. Honestly, that’s all I ask for in office supplies. Of course, this isn’t meant for industrial-level stapling or massive packets, but for everyday home, school, or office use, it’s more than enough. If you need something reliable for regular paperwork, this fits the bill perfectly. Overall, I’m really happy with this purchase. It’s affordable, comes with staples, feels sturdy, and works smoothly every time. It’s officially become my go-to stapler, and I don’t see myself replacing it anytime soon. Highly recommended for anyone who wants a dependable, no-nonsense stapler that just works — practical, sturdy, and absolutely worth it.
reviews.author: AHOSEAJRJHNRD72TKKQGFOY53LUA

reviews.reviewTitle: Easy to use, Easy to load the staples, very affordable
reviews.reviewDescription: This may just be a basic stapler, but it works very well. It advertises that it can staple 25 sheets, but I was able to staple 29 together, and the crimp on the last sheet was still sufficient to hold them together. If you're only doing 10 or fewer sheets at one time, it is quite easy to hold the stapler in your hand to staple. Anything over 10, it's best to put it on a table and push down to staple them together. The kit comes with a little box that contains 1000 staples. You can put 2 packs of staples into the stapler at one time. The spring inside the stapler will continue to push out more staples even when you get down to the last staple without jamming.
reviews.author: AER5RQYPIYE3B5NGKSPUIGU6Q3JQ

reviews.reviewDescription: As a staple in any office environment (pun intended), the Standard Stapler has earned its place on my desk. Here's a breakdown of why this humble office tool stands out: Design and Build Quality: The Standard Stapler boasts a sleek, ergonomic design that feels solid in hand. The metal construction ensures durability and longevity, while the smooth, matte finish provides a comfortable grip. It’s not overly heavy, which is great for extended use, but it feels sturdy enough to handle a good amount of stapling without wobbling. Performance: This stapler excels in reliability. It staples through stacks of up to 20 sheets of paper with ease, thanks to its robust mechanism. The staple-loading process is straightforward—just slide open the back, pop in a new strip of staples, and you’re good to go. I’ve had no issues with jams, which is a huge plus. When it does encounter a jam, clearing it is a breeze. Ease of Use: The Standard Stapler’s design is intuitive. The staple-driving action is smooth and requires minimal effort, making it accessible for both left and right-handed users. The stapler also features a non-skid base that prevents it from sliding around on the desk, which adds to its usability. Versatility: One feature that sets this stapler apart is its ability to staple both standard and mini staples. This versatility means you can switch between different sizes based on your needs, which is a nice touch for various tasks. Aesthetics: Available in a range of colors, the Standard Stapler can easily blend into any office décor. Its clean lines and understated design make it an unobtrusive addition to your workspace. Value for Money: Priced competitively, this stapler offers excellent value for its cost. It’s reliable, efficient, and built to last, making it a smart investment for both home and office use. Final Thoughts: The Standard Stapler is a dependable and well-crafted tool that performs its job with precision. While it may not have the bells and whistles of some high-end models, its straightforward design and solid performance make it a standout choice for anyone in need of a reliable stapler. If you're in the market for a no-fuss, high-quality stapler, this one is hard to beat.
reviews.author: AG25UJOUKWBHCURIMDCHUUYULOOA

reviews.reviewDescription: This stapler works good on papers, even on thick papers it works really well. It feels solid and well made, staples smoothly without jamming, and it handles multiple pages effortlessly. I have used it for everything from a few sheets to thicker stacks, and it works every time with no issues. The grip is comfortable, the mechanism is smooth, and it doesn't require much force to staple, which is a big plus for daily use. It also looks clean and professional on m desk. It comes with a small box of staples, which is really good. It will last for a while.
